name: 0.1.0-beta.13
notes:
# Folian 0.1.0-beta.13

- Adds Folian licence activation for purchased copies.
- One Folian licence can be used on up to two Macs.
- Activated copies continue working offline.
- Adds licence management and deactivation of this Mac.
- Keeps writing, projects and backups local. Existing writing, saving and exports remain available if a licence needs attention.

For Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 12 or later.
